purpose: Exact canonical Seller API operation anchors observed in Ozon-owned notification links. This registry does not assert full method contracts.
authority: Verified @OzonSellerAPI notifications whose method migration links include docs.ozon.ru Seller API #operation anchors.
rules: Only anchors visible in Ozon-owned notification evidence are recorded.
An operation anchor confirms the canonical locator/name association, not HTTP verb/full schema/current limits.
Do not reuse an older-version operation anchor for a newer path unless Ozon explicitly links the newer path to that anchor.
Interactive docs redirect failure does not invalidate the anchor, but it keeps full_contract=false.
